name: Storm (Pyramid X)

abilityDetails.Energy Resistance: Enerji hasarlı saldırı ve yeteneklerden gelen hasarı azaltır.
abilityDetails.Passive Stun: Belirli şartlarda rakibi tetikleme olmadan sersemletir.
abilityDetails.Pre-Fight: Dövüş başlamadan önce Pre-Fight ekranından değiştirilebilen yetenek.
abilityDetails.Glancing: Sıyırma vuruşları kritik olamaz, %50 azalmış hasar verir ve saldırı yetenek doğruluğu %100 düşer.
abilityDetails.Slow: Düşmanın Durdurulamaz (Unstoppable) ve Kaçış (Evade) yeteneklerini iptal eder.
abilityDetails.Coldsnap: Ani soğuk hasarı verir ve düşmanın Kaçış yeteneğini kapatır.
abilityDetails.Shock: Zamanla elektrik tabanlı şok hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Instant Shock: Zamanla elektrik tabanlı şok hasarı verir.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): Özel saldırılar hariç %60 kaçış şansı var (kaçış ofansif yetenekleri ve kritikleri engeller). Prowess kaldıran ve güç çalan şampiyonlar kullan.
signatureAbility:
Wrath of Ororo Munroe
While below [10 - 30]% of her maximum health Storm activates both Tempests.
Landing a Heavy Attack activates Storm's alternate Tempest for up to [15] seconds based on how long the Heavy Attack was charged. The tempest will not activate while already active, and is paused during Heavy Attacks and Special Attacks.

abilitySections.title: Passive
content: Storm's basic attacks deal Energy Damage instead of Physical.
Storm has [1,833.33] Energy Resistance.
If the Opponent Purifies a Stun Debuff it is replaced with a Passive Stun lasting 1.5 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Pre-Fight Ability
content: By default, Ice Tempest is selected. If selecting a different Tempest in the Pre-Fight Screen, it becomes the new default. Default Tempests can be switched once per Fight.
When Power Locked or Power Drained, Tempests are removed for 8 seconds.
Activation of Tempests is unaffected by Ability Accuracy.
Ice Tempest: Gain Immunity to Coldsnap and Frostbite, and incoming Basic Attacks have a 60% chance to Glance.

Lightning Tempest: Decrease the potency of incoming Shock effects by 100%. If selected as the default Tempest, each active Prowess grants hits a 2% chance to inflict a Stun Debuff for 0.9 second(s). This Stun is Passive instead if the Opponent has an Endurance effect. Max: 16% chance.

abilitySections.title: When Knocked Down
content: When Knocked Down, if not already active, Storm activates her Alternate Tempest for 12 seconds. Duration is paused during Heavy Attacks and Special Attacks.

abilitySections.title: Prowess - When Either Champion Fills a Bar of Power:
content: Each Tempest generates 1 Prowess, increasing the next Special Attacks damage by 40%. The first 3 Prowess Buffs last indefinitely. Additional Prowess Buffs last 10 seconds. Max 12.
If Storm has 6 Prowess effects active during a Special Attack, gain a Passive Unblockable for 2 second(s).

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: Charging a Heavy Attack creates a dormant Prowess which charges from 0 to 100%.

Launching a Special Attack while charging a Heavy Attack converts this dormant Prowess into a Passive Prowess increasing the Special Attacks damage by up to 100% based on how long the Heavy Attack was charged.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: Inflict a Passive Slow for the duration of this Special Attack.

Ice Tempest: Each hit grants a 10% Prowess Buff for the remainder of this Special Attack. Additionally, the final Hit inflicts a [8,447.2] Coldsnap Passive for 14 seconds, scaling with Special Damage.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: Each hit inflicts a [5,279.5] Shock Debuff for 9 seconds. When one of these Debuffs is Purified, inflict a [5,279.5] Instant Shock Passive. Both of these effects scale with Special Damage.

Lightning Tempest: If selected as the default Tempest, Shock potency is increased by up to 90% based on the Opponent's current Power. Additionally, each Prowess reduces the Opponent's Defense Combat Power Rate by 25%.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: If both Tempests are already active, Storm increases her Attack Rating by [15,838.5] during this Special Attack.
After this Special Attack ends, Storm activates her alternate Tempest for 35 seconds. This duration is paused while charging Heavy Attacks and launching Special Attacks.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Wrath of Ororo Munroe
content: While below [10 - 30]% of her maximum health Storm activates both Tempests.

Landing a Heavy Attack activates Storm's alternate Tempest for up to [15] seconds based on how long the Heavy Attack was charged. The tempest will not activate while already active, and is paused during Heavy Attacks and Special Attacks.
